pageSubtitle: A preview of possible interfaces for AI Compute Map data. These endpoints are a planning draft, not a live service.

status.title: The API is not online yet
status.body: The current public release is a static website backed by versioned repository data. No API hostname, authentication flow, rate limit, SDK, or service-level commitment is currently offered.
status.availability: Use the website or repository data today; treat every endpoint below as a proposal that may change.

apiReference.title: Proposed endpoint outline
apiReference.description: This outline records a possible future interface for discussion. It is not an OpenAPI contract and cannot be called.
